card.name: Catholic and Christian church reference text
card.fires_on: Words inside Christian church and Catholic encyclopedia text, such as 'church' itself, titles of church documents, and citation lines of the New Advent / Catholic Encyclopedia. It often fires on ordinary words where a church term could come next.
